cardId.description: The Card, read only when state is card. An id the server does not know is stored as unidentified and reported for that Slot.

state.description: empty: no card; card: holds the Card in cardId; unidentified: holds a card not yet identified.

card.description: The Card in the pocket, set only when State is card.

column.description: Column of the pocket on its Page, from 1.

state.description: empty: no card; card: holds Card; unidentified: holds a card the app could not identify.

cardId.description: The Card to place in the Slot. A Slot that held a Card gives it up; an Unidentified Slot stops being Unidentified.

from.description: The filled Slot to move the card from.

to.description: The Slot to move the card to. If it holds a card, the two cards swap.

from.description: The Page the card left, read after the move.

to.description: The Page the card went to, read after the move.

cardId.description: The Card stored in the Slot, set only when State is card.

column.description: Column of the Slot on its Page, from 1.

reason.description: Why the Slot was stored differently from the request: unknown_card when the Card id is not known.

items.description: Changes applied in order, at most 100.

cardId.description: The Card to change. Must be unique within the request (400 otherwise).

quantity.description: Absolute target quantity. 0 removes the Card.

contentType.description: The Content-Type the PUT must carry; it is part of the signature.

maxCardCount.description: Hard cap on the Collection's summed card quantity; 0 means no limit.

binder.description: The binder's Layout, or null when the Collection is a plain box or deck.

expansionSetId.description: The Expansion Set the Card belongs to (422 if unknown).

localId.description: The collector number within the set, e.g. "001". A number the set already has is a 409; it cannot be changed afterwards.

rarityId.description: A Rarity of the set's Game. Defaults to "Tanpa Tanda".

tags.description: Only a Trainer card carries tags; Pokémon and Energi cards leave them empty (422 otherwise).

code.description: The set's code, e.g. SM-P. A code the set's Game already has is a 409; the code cannot be changed afterwards.

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

code.description: A stable machine-readable code for the failure, set only when a client is meant to branch on it. login_required: this needs a signed-in caller. binder_quantity_locked: a binder's quantities change only by placing or clearing Slots. collection_not_empty: a Layout needs a Collection with no Inventory Entries. binder_layout_locked: rows, columns or the Layout cannot change while a Slot holds a card. binder_leaf_in_use: the Leaf has a card on one of its Pages. binder_max_card_count: a binder's capacity is its Slot count, so max_card_count must stay 0. photo_storage_not_configured: this server has no private photo bucket, so no scan photo upload address can be signed.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

message.description: Human-readable reason for a declined item.

status.description: applied: set or created; removed: deleted, or already absent; declined: not applied.

positions.description: Where the Card sits in a binder: one position per Slot holding it, in Page order. Absent in a plain Collection.

score.description: How closely the photo matches this Card; candidates are ordered by it, highest first.

confident.description: True only when the server is sure of the first candidate. The server owns the threshold.

items.description: Cards to place, in order, at most 100.

cardId.description: The Card to place. Must be unique within the request (400 otherwise).

quantity.description: Copies to place, one empty Slot each.

count.description: How many photos are to be uploaded. One address comes back per photo.

illustrator.description: Left out, it clears the Card's illustrator.

rarityId.description: A Rarity of the Card's Game (422 otherwise).

tags.description: Only a Trainer card carries tags; Pokémon and Energi cards leave them empty (422 otherwise).

seriesId.description: An existing Series of the set's Game (422 otherwise). The set's code is not editable.
